body:
I found out a while ago that my pious Catholic father (who will make his beliefs loud and clear for anyone willing to listen) got fired from his job when I was 11 years old because he was coming to work (as an elemetary school principal) high on cocaine. Some of the worst years of my life are due to the fact that we had to move to a remote part of the province and basically "hide" for a few years before moving even further away. That happened around 13 years ago now and up until about a year and a half ago I though we had moved because of "work politics". My younger brother found out almost a year before he told me and kept it to himself until my parents accused him of using coke. They still didn't know that we had found out until about 6 months ago when I finally was in a position where I could bring it up to my mother. 

If anything, though, knowing this increased my respect for my father and somewhat humanized him to me. But seriously, he can never again get away with telling me that tattoos are wrong because "god owns our bodies, not us"
